Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fluent-bit && grep -RIn "flb_msgpack_to_json(out_buf\|msgpack_pack_map(&tmp_pck, map_size\|msgpack_pack_object(&tmp_pck, \*k)" src/flb_pack.c && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"tests/internal/fuzzers/msgpack_parse_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":6,"var":"data,size","code":"flb_msgpack_raw_to_json_sds(data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are passed directly into the msgpack-to-JSON conversion path when the input is exactly 512 bytes."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/flb_pack.c","function":"flb_msgpack_raw_to_json_sds","line":617,"var":"in_buf,in_size","code":"out_size = in_size * 1.5; out_buf = flb_sds_create_size(out_size);","note":"The converter allocates an output buffer based on the raw input size before validating the msgpack structure."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/flb_pack.c","function":"flb_msgpack_raw_to_json_sds","line":625,"var":"result.data","code":"msgpack_unpack_next(&result, in_buf, in_size, &off); root = &result.data;","note":"The first msgpack object is unpacked from attacker data and becomes the root object used for conversion."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/flb_pack.c","function":"flb_msgpack_to_json","line":0,"var":"root.via.array.ptr[1]","code":"root is expected to be a two-element array [time, map] and the second element is treated as a map record.","note":"The conversion logic assumes the unpacked root has the expected array/map shape and dereferences nested fields accordingly."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/flb_pack.c","function":"flb_msgpack_raw_to_json_sds","line":629,"var":"ret","code":"ret = flb_msgpack_to_json(out_buf, out_size, root);","note":"The unpacked object is serialized into JSON; malformed nested msgpack can drive the serializer into an invalid size/accounting state."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/flb_pack.c","function":"flb_msgpack_raw_to_json_sds","line":631,"var":"out_buf","code":"tmp_buf = flb_sds_increase(out_buf, 256);","note":"When serialization fails or needs more space, the code grows the destination buffer and retries, exercising the same malformed object again."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/flb_pack.c","function":"flb_msgpack_to_json","line":0,"var":"output write cursor","code":"JSON emission writes into the preallocated SDS buffer while traversing the attacker-controlled msgpack map and values.","note":"The sink is a write into the heap-backed output buffer during recursive msgpack-to-JSON emission, which is where the heap-buffer-overflow occurs."}
]
print(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
